QUANT LAB
Probability lab · interview puzzles

Expectation puzzles.

Each puzzle has its own page: an exact answer, a seeded simulation that checks it, and controls to change the numbers.

Titles come from a public practice list. The statements are our own versions. Where a title leaves the rules open, the puzzle is marked assumed version and its page says which rules were chosen.
Exact answers are checked against hand-derived values and against simulation (within 4 standard errors) by a script before publishing.
